text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock an MVP choplist for the Apr milestone (target 2026-04-05). I sketched a minimal set below and a proposal to slip non-critical infra into v1. Call out any hard blockers by EOD, otherwise I’ll lock.

sam: +1 to deferring heavy infra. main worry is support burden if we remove the multitenant admin UX entirely. Can we do an API-only admin + a lightweight modal for basic ops?

jordan: Agree. Also: telemetry baseline needs to stay (errors, latency, token cost). If we cut telemetry, ops will be blind on day 1.

maya: Design can ship an admin modal (single screen, read-only controls + one action). Low dev cost, helps support while we push full multitenant admin to v1.

elaine: OK — here's my proposal (very compact). If you disagree, paste :point_up: with edits.

```
MVP (ship 2026-04-05):
- Core text generation routes (chat + stream)
- Embeddings + simple semantic search
- Embedding cache (hot prefix)
- Basic telemetry (errors, p50/p95 latency, per-route token counters)
- API-only admin + lightweight admin modal (read-only ops + restart)
- Default model (verified quantized) with fallback routing to a cheaper variant

Defer to v1 (post-mvp):
- Full multitenant admin UI and role-based tenancy
- Model pinning / advanced rollout controls
- Advanced batching/caching tuning UI
- On-prem private control plane GA
```

els: question: does anyone object to keeping the embedding cache in MVP? it's a small infra piece but gives big cost win for semantic workloads.

sam: keep cache. it reduces token spend and will be helpful for our pilot customers.

jordan: keeping telemetry + cache = must-have. otherwise we can’t validate cost targets.

maya: design note: admin modal + cache status tile ✅. I’ll scope assets for 2 screens and a small icon set.

elaine: timeline ask — given the deferrals above, can eng hit 04-05 or do we need a timebox slip? I can accept a 2-week slip if we avoid scope creep.

sam: realistic: with current taskboard we’re tight. I think +1 week if we keep the trimmed scope, +2 weeks if we try to polish the modal more than the planned lightweight.

jordan: dev blockers: dependency on runtime kernel update (PR #462). If that lands by 03-18 we’re on track. If not, +2 weeks.

elaine: action items then:
- @sam: confirm runtime PR status and confirm 03-18 gating risk (due 03-15)
- @jordan: lock telemetry minimal checklist (errors, p50/p95, per-route counters) by 03-16
- @maya: deliver modal mocks + assets by 03-20 (we’ll keep it intentionally tiny)
- @elaine: lock MVP choplist by EOD unless a strong objection is posted

sam: noted — I’ll ping infra and put a status update in the PR.

jordan: I’ll post the telemetry checklist in the thread tomorrow.

maya: mock ETA ok.

elaine: final: unless I get a hard objection by 18:00 PT today I’ll mark this as the MVP scope and start reassigning stories. If runtime PR slips we reconvene for a 2-week timeline reset.

sam: :thumbsup:

dev-bot: Reminder: sprint cutpoint closes 2026-03-21 23:59 UTC. Any scope moves after that require approval from Eng + Product leads.

elaine: thanks all — locking soon unless flagged.
